service_descriptor: Weekly product research for clearer test decisions
tax_wording: Plus legally applicable taxes, if any.
delivery_cadence: Four weekly PDF-and-Excel reports each month.
delivery_channel: Email delivery with a WhatsApp notification and download link.
initial_price_period: Price fixed for the first two months.
opportunity_limit: Up to 12 eligible opportunities in each weekly report. A shorter list is used when the evidence is weaker.
implementation_target: Setup normally takes seven days after the service is confirmed and the required branding and access are ready.
call_to_action: Choose a start date and confirm the service with NeuraFlow.
included: Four weekly PDF-and-Excel reports each month
Up to 12 eligible opportunities in each report
Week-over-week changes after a comparable earlier report
Possible supplier leads where evidence is available
excluded: Guaranteed counts, demand, sales, margin, profit, or performance
Supplier contact, negotiation, audit, recommendation, or verification
Compliance, certification, safety, or legal decisions
Ad creation, media buying, or store integration
Software login, real-time monitoring, or daily alerts
client_responsibilities: Decide which products, if any, deserve further testing
Check product compliance, warnings, age guidance, and claims
Check supplier identity, stock, terms, and suitability
Sample product quality, packaging, delivery, and returns
Calculate landed cost, pricing, margin, and business risk
